propositions: Schema-drift defect in _mcp_models.BridgeFsckOut was already fixed on main; the comment citing CI-enforced drift gate is now accurate and should remain unmodified.
Fast MCP tool docstrings in _mcp_llm.py and read-via markers in _config_schema.py are machine-consumed by CI gates and must not be deleted.
_config_schema.py contains ~280 comment lines that serve as the sole documentation for many configuration keys, and documentation must not be lost by bulk trimming.
Three inline rationale blocks in review_bot were successfully relocated to ADRs 0067, 0068, and 0069 with one-line citations replacing the original inline text.
The corrected scope achieved a net-near-zero comment-line delta (10 removed / 14 added in code files) while homing four verified-stale comments and preserving all load-bearing invariants.
